---
title: "Horizontal rule keeps Quarto's look"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      # Pandoc 3.13 writer emits #divider() for HorizontalRule; Quarto's
      # template aliases divider to its centered 25-75% horizontalrule.
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['\#divider\(\)', '\#let divider\(\) = horizontalrule']
        - ['std\.divider']
      noErrors: default
---
